objectsSameEngine: Views and procedures can only be carried between databases of the same engine

table.copyLeft: Copy the table to the left
table.copyRight: Copy the table to the right
table.createLeft: Create the table on the left
table.createRight: Create the table on the right
table.deleteLeft: Delete the table on the left
table.deleteRight: Delete the table on the right

object.copyLeft: Copy the object to the left
object.copyRight: Copy the object to the right
object.createLeft: Create the object on the left
object.createRight: Create the object on the right
object.deleteLeft: Delete the object on the left
object.deleteRight: Delete the object on the right

pk.copyLeft: Copy the primary key to the left
pk.copyRight: Copy the primary key to the right

props.copyLeft: Copy the comment and options to the left
props.copyRight: Copy the comment and options to the right

sync.unsupported: {{engine}} doesn't apply schema changes from DBine
sync.confirmWarnings: Check the warnings before going on.
sync.noChanges: Nothing to sync: carry changes with the → / ← arrows
sync.changes_one: {{count}} change (left: {{left}}, right: {{right}}): see the scripts and run them
sync.changes_many: {{count}} changes (left: {{left}}, right: {{right}}): see the scripts and run them
sync.changes_other: {{count}} changes (left: {{left}}, right: {{right}}): see the scripts and run them
sync.confirmOrder: Left first, then right; if anything fails, it stops there.
sync.emptyScript: This side has pending changes, but the script is empty: there is no statement to apply them. Nothing will run here. Review the changes or discard them.

empty.pick: Choose the two databases (or two schemas) and click {compare}.
empty.help: Differences are carried from one side to the other with the arrows and applied with {sync}, which shows the script before running it.

pickItem: Choose a table or object from the list.
